milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The podzol is placed in a 7x7 patch centered at spawn (0,-1,0) spawn-relative. Target is the center of the podzol patch. max_distance=5 is generous since the player spawns directly on it. facing_tolerance=80 allows the player to look generally downward toward the ground to 'see' the podzol. This rule type was chosen over position_inside_box because find tasks should verify the player can actually observe the target, not just stand near it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task requiring navigation. Oxeye daisies are placed in a meadow cluster southeast of spawn at positions (8,0,7), (10,0,9), (7,0,11), (12,0,8), (9,0,13), (14,0,10). Target is (10,0,9) — the approximate center of the daisy cluster. max_distance=10 requires the player to walk several blocks from spawn toward the meadow (spawn-to-target distance is ~13.4 blocks, so the player must close at least ~3.4 blocks). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the daisies, confirming visual observation rather than just passing nearby. This rule type was chosen because it models 'player can see the target' which is the core requirement of a find task.
